主要内容: The document titled '6-K' is a report filed by the Royal Bank of Canada with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). It is part of the Form 6-K filing, which is used by foreign private issuers to report information to the SEC. The filing includes the First Quarter 2015 Earnings Release, the Report to Shareholders, and the Industry Guide 3 on Return on Equity and Assets Ratios. The report is incorporated by reference into several Registration Statements on Form F-3 and S-8. The filing was made on February 25, 2015, and signed by Janice R. Fukakusa, the Chief Administrative Officer and Chief Financial Officer of the Royal Bank of Canada. This filing provides detailed financial and operational information for the bank's first quarter of 2015.
